description: This file defines the ScoreRepository class, responsible for managing game score data in an SQLite database. It provides methods for initializing the database connection, retrieving, updating, inserting, and resetting scores, as well as maintaining a leaderboard.

classes.name: ScoreRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling CRUD operations and game score management using an SQLite database.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter that returns the active database or throws if not initialized.

methods.name: upsertScore
methods.description: Creates or updates a player's score entry in the database.

methods.name: getScoreByPlayer
methods.description: Retrieves a player's score by name.

methods.name: incrementResult
methods.description: Updates scores based on game result, incrementing wins, losses, or draws.

methods.name: _ensureRowExists
methods.description: Ensures a player row exists in the database, inserting if necessary.

methods.name: _incrementWinInternal
methods.description: Increments the win count for a player.

methods.name: _incrementLossInternal
methods.description: Increments the loss count for a player.

methods.name: _incrementDrawInternal
methods.description: Increments the draw count for a player.

methods.name: getLeaderboard
methods.description: Returns a list of top players ordered by their scores.

methods.name: resetAllScores
methods.description: Deletes all scores and resets default entries for 'You' and 'Friend'.
